title: Dimglass Coast - Salt Wind, Last Light
_note: Mood sibling, pensive. gbc 4-voice, no chords. 112 BPM, 4/4, E minor (relative minor of the anchor's G). Same wandering travel line but WISTFUL - longer held notes, the leap reaching out over dark water rather than skipping. Vesper contour intact in minor, lift stretched/yearning (B3->E4->F#4 ... G4->F#4->E4 settle). Sibling color to Tinderwick B. Harmony = slower, airier Tide arps with more gaps. Bass = deeper, more rolling wave swell. Percussion = sparser foam-wash, no fills, just tide. 16-bar loop ~34s.

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: Wandering wistful line in Em, Vesper contour stretched. Longer held notes, the leap yearns. Last bar leans on B (V of Em) into bar 1.
